children: Forward Air shares rose Wednesday after the company signed a two-year agreement to retain its relationship with one of its largest customers.
The transportation services company said the unidentified customer has agreed to continue using the company for a significant portion of the services currently provided for a two-year term.
It also provides for the orderly transition of certain services currently provided to the customer, which is expected to occur between November of this year and March of next.

Forward Air estimates that expanding volumes in the retained business will keep total annual revenue from the customer above 2025 levels over the next three years, securing predictable cash flows without disrupting 2026 financial targets.
